title: Understanding Latent Diffusability via Fisher Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2604.02751v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion models often degrade in latent spaces, yet the formal causes remain poorly understood. We quantify latent-space diffusability via the rate of change of the Minimum Mean Squared Error (MMSE) along the diffusion trajectory. Our framework decomposes this MMSE rate into contributions from Fisher Information (FI) and Fisher Information Rate (FIR). We show that isometric embeddings preserve intrinsic FI and establish quantitative intrinsic-FI bounds for a broader class of bi-Lipschitz encoders with controlled weak volume distortion, whereas FIR is governed by the interplay between encoder and data geometries. Our analysis separates four geometric contributions in local stability bounds for Gaussian-smoothed FIR: dimensional compression, tangential distortion, high-frequency encoder curvature, and curvature of data manifold. translated_title: 通过费舍尔几何理解潜空间扩散性
translated_abstract: 扩散模型在潜空间中常常出现性能退化，但其根本原因至今仍缺乏深入理解。我们通过最小均方误差（MMSE）沿扩散轨迹的变化率来量化潜空间的扩散性。我们的框架将该MMSE变化率分解为费舍尔信息（FI）和费舍尔信息变化率（FIR）的贡献。我们证明了等距嵌入能够保持内蕴FI，并为更广泛的一类具有受控弱体积畸变的双利普希茨编码器建立了定量的内蕴FI界，而FIR则由编码器几何与数据几何之间的相互作用所决定。我们的分析在高斯平滑FIR的局部稳定性界中分离出四种几何贡献：维度压缩、切向畸变、高频编码器曲率以及数据流形曲率。在多种自编码架构上开展的实验为这一几何机制提供了定性支持。
tldr: 该论文提出用MMSE变化率量化潜空间扩散性并将其分解为费舍尔信息与费舍尔信息变化率的贡献，首次从几何角度揭示了维度压缩、切向畸变、编码器曲率和数据流形曲率四种因素如何导致扩散模型在潜空间中的退化。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies latent-space diffusability via the MMSE rate of change, decomposing it into Fisher Information and Fisher Information Rate contributions, and identifies four geometric factors—dimensional compression, tangential distortion, encoder curvature, and data manifold curvature—that govern the degradation of diffusion models in latent spaces.
